name: Life Is Better in the Biodome
source:
RS03 is content to perform his job as one of the Libra Corporation's Biomechanics Officers—almost. Despite their assurances that this is the best path for him, he can't shake the feeling that something is missing from his life. That someone is missing.

[From [url=https://grantsables.itch.io/life-is-better-in-the-biodome]itch.io[/url]]
